# MemoVR Player

**Make VR a simpler way to record life**

## Overview

- Browse and manage standard SBS ERP VR180 MP4, JPG, and PNG files.
- Open native VR-camera video and JPG/PNG photos with real-time stabilization—no complex export step after shooting (currently DJI Osmo 360 modded and QooCam 3 Ultra modded; more cameras to follow).
- Supports on-device storage, camera USB, and LAN SMB shares (read/write enables delete) for easier VR media management.
